const API_URL = "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbyjl7s2T-ClJxtkEQ8J8ksyVTfILGtPCOZ5dssjWq9zJM-4_3Dm6Sz4FJzmMHcYFw5f/exec"; // Load records from Google Sheets function loadRecords() { const callbackName = "docsTrackerCallback_" + Date.now(); window[callbackName] = function (result) { try { if (!result.success) { console.error("Unable to load records"); return; } console.log("Records loaded:", result.records); // TODO: Display result.records in your existing table. // Map the fields to the actual columns used by your website. } finally { delete window[callbackName]; script.remove(); } }; const script = document.createElement("script"); script.src = API_URL + "?callback=" + encodeURIComponent(callbackName); script.onerror = function () { delete window[callbackName]; script.remove(); console.error("Failed to connect to Google Sheets"); }; document.body.appendChild(script); } // Save a new record to Google Sheets async function saveRecord(record) { try { await fetch(API_URL, { method: "POST", mode: "no-cors", headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain;charset=utf-8" }, body: JSON.stringify(record) }); // no-cors cannot confirm whether the server saved the record. // Verify by reloading records or checking the spreadsheet. console.log("Save request sent"); } catch (error) { console.error("Save request failed:", error); } } // Load when the page opens document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", loadRecords);
